summary: performance lens over explain-grounding-and-attestation (16 product path(s), 6fa3a6d..5d37131, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 2 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The patch leaves a blocking compatibility path in grounded chat wiring, accepts replaced/inactive pinned batches, and introduces quadratic per-request metadata construction that can become costly at the supported outline scale.

blocking_findings.summary: Reject inactive pinned batches during grounding verification (backend/src/chat/statement-grounding.service.ts:63): `DrillBatch` exposes `isActive`, and the test fixtures deliberately populate it, but verification accepts any stored batch whose id, source, and period match.

Make StatementGroundingService a required ChatService dependency (backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts:66): `ChatModule` always registers `StatementGroundingService`, so the optional constructor parameter and the subsequent “grounding unavailable” branch exist only to preserve callers that construct `ChatService` without its new dependency.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Index leaf targets before building per-leaf metadata (backend/src/mis/mis-statement.service.ts:413): Each outline leaf scans the complete `resolution.leafTargets` array with `filter`, making statement generation O(outline leaves × mapping targets) on every resolved request.
